maddeler.e:
اعتزمن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمْنَ (iʕtazamna) /iʕ.ta.zam.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اُعْتُزِمْنَ (uʕtuzimna) /uʕ.tu.zim.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزِمْنَ (iʕtazimna) /iʕ.ta.zim.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
